item.title: Sauk Prairie Healthcare addresses ongoing workforce challenges
item.description: The Wisconsin Hospital Association released its 2026 Wisconsin Health Care Workforce Report on Feb. 2, revealing that while some progress has been made in stabilizing workforce shortages, vacancy rates remain high across the state’s hospitals, including Sauk Prairie Healthcare.

item.title: Eilertson wins Dippel Award
item.description: Baraboo Kiwanis will honor Rick Eilertson’s extensive volunteer work at 5:30 p.m. Tuesday, April 28 at Mike’s Italian Restaurant, 630 W Pine St, Baraboo, when he is awarded the Dr. Al Dippel Community Service Award.
